rationales.authenticity: Historical fact (no wolves in Ireland by 1820) woven naturally into character; 'mo chara' adds warmth; the deflection is entirely period-appropriate.
rationales.character: Brigid's firm, boundary-setting expertise is perfectly realized; she knows her domain and politely redirects without condescension.
rationales.craft: Two substantive sentences plus a clarifying line; punchy and effective, though slightly tighter than the ideal 2–4.
rationales.language: Crisp and idiomatic; Irish term well-integrated; rhythm and diction are excellent.
rationales.responsiveness: Directly addresses the sheep concern, explains why it's outside her scope, and points the questioner elsewhere.
